name: App Factory yaşam döngüsü

local_gate.web_gates: no web change in B41; matrix-badges rerun after node scripts/web/sync-feature-matrix.mjs
local_gate.run: 2026-09-15 local, one clean run over the B41 tree (scratchpad b41_gate.log): QUALITY GATE: PASS; API pytest 10804 passed / 5 skipped in 19m44s; staged update qualified; web vitest/tsc/oxlint green; corpus 2357 cases green inside the run

what_this_proves: A generated application is verified by replaying its own browser oracle through the device's browser family, its records survive a real stop/run, its log is read back from the device, it is packaged as a zip whose every file is hashed, the package - and only an intact package - is launched as its own version, its versions and events are remembered, it can be returned to by name, and it can be extended by a later sentence into a new tested version; and none of the lifecycle words fire without an application in focus.

measured_first.before: app/appfactory after B40: create/run/test/fix/open/stop/status/list only; no verify, no persistence check, no log read-back, no release, no launch-from-package, no history, no resume, no modify; the oracle existed only as data the lab would replay.

found_on_the_way.assert_class: the device's browser.find reports tag/role/name/text and no class list; the oracle's assert_class steps are recorded as 'not checked here' rather than claimed.
found_on_the_way.store_on_the_service: the release store is injected (artifacts.store in main and in the harness) so tests use the in-memory store the artifacts already use.
found_on_the_way.b40_model_columns_triplicated: app/appfactory/models.py carried the B40 column block (plan_json … parent_id) three times (a resumable patch re-applied it; SQLAlchemy kept the last copy so nothing failed) - deduplicated to one block.
found_on_the_way.turkish_slug: AppSpec.slug_for_name folded no Turkish letters, so 'Kitaplık' scaffolded as 'kitapl-k'; it now folds çğıöşü the way the composer's slugify already did (the release version's slug is 'kitaplik-release-v1').
found_on_the_way.addition_grammar: parse_addition was the create parser with 'ekle' rewritten as 'tutan', which read 'karanlık tema ekle' as a new record kind 'tema' and 'kitaplara sayfa sayısı ekle' as a kind 'sayısı'; it is now its own grammar (dative → field on a known kind, possessive → field, plural/keep-verb → kind, login → feature, anything else UNPARSED).
found_on_the_way.tool_registration_loop: the seven tools registered from a for-loop were invisible to the self-model indexer (it reads ToolSpec(name=<CONSTANT>) declarations); unrolled into explicit registrations - the same lesson as B39's operator.mission.

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations restored from sha256-verified copies (never git checkout); scratchpad b41_mutate.py.
mutations: M1 the persistence check never restarts the process; it asserts on the same run (444) -> 1 failure(s).
M2 a record that vanished after the restart is still called persistent (444) -> 1 failure(s).
M3 an oracle element the page lacks does not fail the verification (443) -> 1 failure(s).
M4 a release file whose hash differs from its record is launched anyway (442/446) -> 1 failure(s).
M5 the build id ignores file contents (446) -> 1 failure(s).
M6 an untested application is packaged (441) -> 1 failure(s).
M7 a later request adds nothing - the merge drops new record kinds (449) -> 1 failure(s).
M8 resume returns the first version, not the latest (448) -> 1 failure(s).
M9 the lifecycle words fire with no application in focus, stealing 'Bu bug'ı düzelt' from memory (451) -> 1 failure(s).
M10 the log read-back reports lines it never received (445) -> 1 failure(s).
red_first_proof.result: 10/10 red; every file restored to its sha256 before the mutation.

runtime_proof.status: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: the browser family scripted at the device port (the same FakeDeviceAction the operator uses), a real stop/run through the service between the two halves of the verification, the object store the artifacts use, the routes and the voice tools through create_app. The roadmap's PROVEN_REAL (a generated application run, its UI verified, then a feature added, on the owner's device) is READY_FOR_OWNER: it needs the companion's projects family and browser worker on the device (checkpoint 17).

owner_gates.device_lab: on the owner's device: create a composed app by voice, run it, 'Uygulamayı doğrula', 'Uygulamayı paketle', 'Paketlenmiş sürümü başlat', 'Bu uygulamaya ... ekle'.
